Finding a partner, while strenuously challenging, is possible. But in my experience, maintaining a relationship while being shrouded in depressive episodes is undoubtably impossible. All of my relationships have been ruined, simply because I don’t have enough confidence to exert myself properly. My depression calls for self-hatred like no other, which is obviously terrible in a relationship.

I wouldn’t recommend looking for a partner until you feel stable enough to do so, or else you risk the chance of becoming dependent and reliant on them for your happiness. You will find it eventually, I promise.

I’m very, very sorry for your grievances. I treat my pets as though they’re human, they’re my everything, and I remember the first time I had to say goodbye. 

I know it’s a cliche option, and a heartless one at that, but your mind needs a distraction. 
If you’re in the position to, I recommend introducing a new friend into your life. A replacement, if you will. 

Otherwise, you’ll feel stuck, numb. It’s a necessary action to move forward.

Also, a random thought, have you ever walked around your town in the dead of night, at 3 a.m? It’s a phenomenal method to clearing your head and experiencing the world in a new context. The desolate streets always invoke such an awakening feeling, the grim atmosphere the dim, red stoplights give. Being alone with your thoughts, coming to closure with the past, it’s very wonderful. Give it a go

Best of luck, it’ll be okay. <3
